questions.stem: A 35-year-old woman presents to the OPD after a bicycle accident. She has multiple injuries, including an abrasion on her elbow. In assessing her injuries, it is important to understand the characteristics and healing processes of different wound types. Which of the following statements about abrasions is FALSE?
questions.stemHtml: A 35-year-old woman presents to the OPD after a bicycle accident. She has multiple injuries, including an abrasion on her elbow. In assessing her injuries, it is important to understand the characteristics and healing processes of different wound types. Which of the following statements about abrasions is FALSE?

options.label: A
options.text: Abrasions result from friction against a rough surface.

options.label: B
options.text: Abrasions typically heal rapidly with scar formation.

options.label: C
options.text: Corneal abrasion is categorized as grievous hurt.

options.label: D
options.text: Linear abrasion can provide information about the direction of force applied.
